instruction: A low-angle wide shot of three cheerleaders sitting on the floor of a bright white studio. On the left, the curly-haired cheerleader (R1) sits holding orange pom-poms. In the center, the short black-haired cheerleader (R4) sits back-to-back with her. On the right, the dark-haired cheerleader (R13) sits holding pom-poms. All three wear white, red, and yellow crop tops with white skirts and knee-high socks. Bright, high-key studio lighting illuminates the scene.
elements: R4 is the cheerleader sitting back-to-back with R1, not R13
R1 holds orange pom-poms while seated back-to-back with R4
R13 sits separately holding pom-poms rather than joining the back-to-back contact pair

questions.q: Is R4 the cheerleader sitting back-to-back with R1, rather than R13 being the one in back-to-back contact with R1?
questions.element: R4 has the back-to-back contact role with R1

questions.element: R1 is the orange pom-pom holder in the back-to-back pair

questions.q: Is R13 seated apart from the R1-and-R4 back-to-back pair while holding pom-poms?
questions.element: R13 is a separate seated pom-pom holder, not part of the back-to-back contact pair
